# Cncf Pytorch Distributeddataparallel Ddp Reviewer

Review Pytorch DistributedDataParallel (DDP) using its official documentation and repository in the Training / Distributed Training category. DistributedDataParallel (DDP) implements data parallelism at the module level which can run across multiple machines.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
